title: CordFriends
description: Plugin that add /friend add command with a GUI for Bungeecord server compatible with chestcommand and /msg to send to friend in any server and /mail to leave message for offline friend
body:
🤝 Friend System - BungeeCord

Transform your BungeeCord network with a complete friend system, cross-server private messaging, and an intuitive graphical interface! 🚀

📦 Installation

Installation is simple:

1️⃣ BungeeCord

📂 Place the plugin in the following folder:

/plugins

Then restart your BungeeCord proxy.

2️⃣ Spigot / Paper

Also install the Spigot/Paper version of the plugin on every server in your network.

After installation, restart each server to ensure all features are fully operational.

⚠️ Both parts (BungeeCord + Spigot/Paper) are required for the plugin to function properly.

✅ Compatibility

🖥️ Compatible with ChestCommands

To open the GUI directly, use the following command:

op: execute as @s run friend gui
👥 Friend System

Easily manage your friends with:

/ friend add
/friend accept
/friend deny
/friend remove
/friend list
/friend requests

✨ When a player sends you a friend request, clickable buttons appear in chat, allowing you to instantly accept or deny the request.

🚫 Block System

Prevent specific players from contacting you:

/friend block
/friend unblock
/friend blocked

Blocked players will no longer be able to:

❌ Send you a friend request
❌ Send you a private message
❌ Send you offline mail
💬 Cross-Server Private Messaging

Communicate with any player across your network using:

/msg
/r

⚡ Messages are delivered instantly, even if the recipient is connected to another server.

📬 If the recipient is offline, the message is automatically stored as offline mail.

✉️ Offline Mail

Send messages even when a player is offline:

/mail send
/mail read
/mail clear

By default, every player can send offline mail, whether they are friends or not.

⚙️ This behavior is fully configurable.

🎯 Smart Tab Completion

All commands include intelligent TAB completion:

✅ Subcommands
✅ Relevant player names

Making command usage much faster and easier.

🖥️ Graphical User Interface

Open the menu with:

/friend gui

From the GUI, you can:

👥 View your friends list
🎮 Join a friend's server with one click
💬 Send a private message directly
🌐 Network-Wide Synchronization

The entire plugin logic is handled directly by BungeeCord, which centralizes all network data.

This allows every feature to work seamlessly across all servers on your network.

✨ A single installation on your BungeeCord proxy is all that's needed to synchronize friends, private messages, and offline mail across your entire network.
